Plot patterns in composition residuals by bin or year

Source: R/plot_composition_diagnostics.R
plot_composition_residual_pattern.Rd

Plot the mean Pearson residual for each bin (across years) or each year (across bins), with a runs test for non-random patterns in the signs of the residuals. These plots summarize the stripes that can appear in residual bubble plots, for example, consistently negative residuals at older ages caused by mis-specified selectivity.

plot_composition_residual_pattern(
  dat,
  by = c("bin", "year"),
  comp_type = NULL,
  fleet = NULL,
  ncol = NULL,
  direction = "v"
)

Arguments

dat

A tibble returned from convert_output() that contains composition data (see bigskate_lencomp), or composition data in any other format accepted by prepare_composition_data().

by

String. Summarize residuals by "bin" (age or length) or by "year". Default: "bin"

comp_type

String. Type of composition to keep when dat contains more than one. Options: "age", "length", or NULL (keep all). Default: NULL

fleet

Character or numeric vector. Fleet(s) to keep, matching either the fleet name (e.g., "Fishery_current") or the fleet name with its partition (e.g., "Fishery_current (retained)"). NULL keeps all fleets. Default: NULL

ncol

Number. Number of facet columns. NULL lets ggplot2 choose. Default: NULL

direction

String. Order of the panels: "v" fills panels down each column and then across, so consecutive years are stacked vertically and cohorts are easier to follow from panel to panel; "h" fills panels across each row.

Default: "v"

Value

A ggplot2 object.

Details

Vertical lines are plus and minus two standard errors of the mean residual. The runs test (Wald-Wolfowitz) is applied to the signs of the residuals ordered by year (when by = "bin") or by bin (when by = "year"). Filled points have fewer runs than expected by chance (one-sided p < 0.05), which indicates a non-random pattern of residuals. When all residuals have the same sign, the p-value is the probability of that happening by chance, \(2 \times 0.5^n\). Residuals are summarized separately for each fleet and sex.

See also

plot_composition_residuals(), plot_composition_residual_distribution(), prepare_composition_data()

Examples

plot_composition_residual_pattern(bigskate_lencomp)

plot_composition_residual_pattern(bigskate_lencomp, by = "year")
